Driven by obsession and forbidden science, a brilliant researcher assembles artificial limbs and resurrects a consciousness from the dead, breathing life into a tragic creature of flesh, steel, and alchemy. As this stitched-together entity awakens to a bleak world, creator and creation are plunged into a harrowing philosophical nightmare about the boundaries of the soul. Burdened by monstrous existence and bitter isolation, the artificial being seeks vengeance against the hands that forged it.
